descriptionChirho: To boast or act arrogantly; used of the proud and boastful who exalt themselves (Qal active, including participle 'the boastful/arrogant'); primarily in Psalms.
To act insanely, behave as a madman, or feign madness (Hitpael reflexive and Qal); used of nations going mad (Jeremiah) and of David feigning madness before Achish (1 Sam 21:14).
To make foolish or drive someone to madness (Piel causative); said of God making diviners and counselors into fools (Job 12:17, Isa 44:25).
